sentences.en: The number of people who go abroad has been increasing.
sentences.zh: 出国的人数一直在增加。

sentences.en: Demand for imported cars is increasing due to lower prices.
sentences.zh: 由于价格降低，对进口汽车的需求正在增加。

sentences.en: This city has been increasing in population year after year.
sentences.zh: 这个城市的人口年复一年地在增长。

senses.zh: 增加，增大，增多( increase的现在分词 ),增强，增进,缝纫放（针）,增强
